parameters.content: Shared n8n error workflow. Import migration 006 and bind Postgres. Publish this workflow before assigning its ID as settings.errorWorkflow on pipeline workflows. The runner also records job retry failures itself; this handler records n8n execution errors for diagnosis.

parameters.jsCode: const e=$json??{};const x=e.execution??{};const w=e.workflow??{};const err=x.error??e.error??{};return [{json:{execution_id:x.id??null,workflow_id:w.id??null,workflow_name:w.name??null,last_node:x.lastNodeExecuted??null,message:String(err.message??e.message??'Unknown n8n execution failure').slice(0,1000)}}];

parameters.query: WITH p AS (SELECT $1::jsonb j) INSERT INTO public.pipeline_errors(execution_id,workflow_id,workflow_name,last_node,message) SELECT j->>'execution_id',j->>'workflow_id',j->>'workflow_name',j->>'last_node',j->>'message' FROM p RETURNING id,created_at;
